summary: Repeating request—first attempt unclear or incomplete
detailed_context: Nick asked to 'Add that python vs go answer to the docs' once already in the immediate prior message. He's now repeating the exact same instruction. This signals either the first response didn't actually execute the task, didn't provide clear confirmation/evidence of the work, or the output wasn't visible. Repetition of a task request is a frustration signal—he wants action taken and needs to see it completed. The previous response likely explained the concept well but failed to show concrete action (file added, location confirmed, etc.).
